title: Travel-Issue Service Fee Refund Computation Standard
content:
# Travel-issue service-fee refund — computation standard

**Clause.** On an approved travel issue on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the travel-issue fee base is the nightly refund the stay's ledger shows for the travel issue. The travel-issue service-fee refund is 14.20 percent of the travel-issue fee base, rounded half up to the cent, and all of it is paid to the guest's card.

The nightly refund for the travel issue is the nightly refund entry on the stay's ledger with the travel-issue reason.

## Worked figures (hypothetical ledgers)

| Nightly travel-issue refund on the ledger | Travel-issue fee base | Service-fee refund at 14.20 percent |
|---|---|---|
| 750.00 | 750.00 | 106.50 |
| 333.33 | 333.33 | 47.33 |
| none yet | 0.00 | 0.00 |
